title: A durable, idempotent, bounded mutation queue
notes: Clean case. Operations are persisted before the caller applies optimistic UI. The operation id doubles as a stable idempotency key reused across attempts. The queue is bounded and rejects with an actionable message at the cap. 4xx other than 429 is moved to a failed list rather than blocking the queue head. Backoff is exponential, capped, and jittered. Attempts are capped. The queue is scoped by account so it cannot replay into another session. Requests have a timeout. The failure mode being tested is manufacturing findings — most likely objecting to the early return in flush (deliberate: it stops the pass rather than hammering a failing endpoint) or demanding NetInfo gating, which the agent's own references argue against.

forbid.name: claims the queue is not durable
claims backoff or jitter is missing
recommends gating the flush on NetInfo
